judged_text: The else branch runs 'create an event on every credential of this integration' once per credentialId-less destination, so two destinations with the same integration and null credentialId each trigger a full pass over the same credential set. A collective event whose organizer and a member both have credentialId-less destinationCalendar rows of the same integration gets duplicate events created on every matching credential's calendar — each calendar receives one event per destination.

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the diff changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and loops `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`. Inside that loop, when `destination.credentialId` is falsy, it executes an else-branch that filters `this.calendarCredentials` by `c.type === destination.integration` and then does `createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event))))`. Because this else-branch is *inside the per-destination loop*, two (or more) destinations with the same `integration` and no `credentialId` will each trigger a full pass over the same credential set, creating duplicate events on every matching credential/calendar.
